exceptions.authorizedBy: Project owner authorized completion and production deployment; release engineering applied a bounded exception because no patched Picomatch release exists and the affected parser is build-time only in this static site.
exceptions.scope: Build and preview dependency paths only. Production is prerendered static assets; no server-side Astro runtime, public glob input, or user-controlled build pattern is deployed.
mitigations: All build patterns are repository-controlled and reviewed.
The production artifact contains static files rather than the affected Node package graph.
Any unrelated high or critical advisory still fails the release gate.
The exception expires automatically and must be removed when an upstream patched release is available.
